annotations.title: Draft a custom tab order (nothing purchased)

description: Use this when the user has their actual list of tab titles (section names, in order) and wants an order drafted: returns the exact price for that build plus an orderUrl that opens Tabzoola's designer with every title pre-filled, for a human to review and complete at checkout. Purchases nothing, reserves nothing, takes no payment; a free PDF proof is emailed before anything prints. Minimum 25 sets, 1-150 titles. Do not use for reverse-printed tabs, PMS ink or custom sheet sizes (quote only) or for anything other than custom-printed tab dividers.

options.description: Optional map of optionKey -> choiceId (see get_pricing_capabilities). Omitted options use defaults.

titles.description: Tab titles in tab order, one per tab (1-150). The title count sets tabs-per-set.
